items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Amos (PHONETIC) stayed -- used to come up there all the time.

ctx.x: Jimmy (unintelligible), Jimmy Amos. I know you don't remember, but (inaudible). He used to come up there all the time. And so they told me, say, "Don't never go out alone when you go out at night." (Unintelligible) call for us to come. Take somebody. Don't never go alone." (Unintelligible).
